text: AI is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can create art, compose music, and even write stories. You can simply type an idea, and the computer will produce a picture or a song in seconds. However, there is an important difference between human and machine creativity. Humans create from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination. AI, on the other hand, learns from millions of examples and then makes something new from that data. It does not truly feel or understand what it creates. So perhaps AI is not replacing human creativity—it is giving us a new tool to explore it.
